scope: Fix only Assert-NoReparseEscape root-boundary traversal for safe media ingestion.

current_exception.observed_behavior: After the source FileInfo is replaced by its parent DirectoryInfo, the function accesses .Directory again. DirectoryInfo has .Parent, not .Directory, so safe ingestion exits 1 before copy and receipt creation.

prohibited_changes: OpenClaw configuration, Binding, Gateway, OAuth, models, Runtime, or Cron
P0 Gate, PROJECT_STATUS, P1, dependencies, and TXT body access
expected_behavior: Normalize SourcePath and AllowedRoot to absolute paths and compare with OrdinalIgnoreCase.
Accept only AllowedRoot itself or a separator-bounded real descendant; E:\safe2 must not match E:\safe.
Check the source item, every parent directory, and AllowedRoot itself for ReparsePoint.
Return success only when the current directory equals AllowedRoot.
Throw if traversal reaches a null parent or a drive root before AllowedRoot.
The same real TXT source ingests once and writes one successful receipt without reading its body.
rollback: Restore the script and test file from reports/backups/P0-MEDIA-ROOT-WALK-001, verify the baseline SHA-256 values, and leave the real TXT receipt absent.

execution_outcome.replacement_test: Unprivileged directory-junction function seam using the production function AST.

tests: PowerShell parser checks for the script and Pester file
Real TXT retry using the same message_id, SourcePath, and InboundRoot
OpenClaw configuration SHA-256 comparison and scoped file review
stop_conditions: SourcePath and InboundRoot resolve to different volumes or SourcePath is not a separator-bounded descendant.
Any root-walk negative test is accepted.
Existing MIME, path traversal, size, hash, receipt, or idempotency regression fails.
Any prohibited configuration or project file changes.
The real TXT retry does not produce the expected single safe receipt.
